U wijst een collega aan die u vertrouwt: You appoint a colleague you trust and choose a waiting period.
Heeft die collega uw kluis nodig, dan vr: If that colleague needs your vault, they request access. You get a notification.
Wijst u het verzoek niet af binnen de wa: If you do not reject the request within the waiting period, the colleague can read your vault.
Uw kluis blijft versleuteld. Uw sleutel: Your vault stays encrypted. Your key is only encrypted for the contact's certificate, never for the server.
Roteert u uw sleutel, dan vervalt de toe: If you rotate your key, your contacts lose their access. Set them up again afterwards.
Deze actie heeft een vers bewijs van uw: This action needs fresh proof of your key, even if the vault is already unlocked. Keepiq asks for this on a sensitive action, such as approving a share or revoking an emergency contact.
Dit verwijdert de herstelenvelop voor An: This deletes the recovery envelope for Anouk Bakker. She can then no longer request emergency access, unless you appoint her as emergency contact again.
